artifacts.summary: Finds the dispatch's counter accumulation/reset defect was already fixed on 2026-09-03 and is pinned green by existing Cases 3/6; the real, currently-failing assertion is Case 1, broken by a later unrelated Status-line grammar check interacting with a stale fixture. Recommends a one-line fixture edit (swap omitted field from Status to Effort) and deleting the known-failures.txt row once green, with no change needed to skill-base.sh, command-gate-out.sh, or validate-artifact.sh's counter logic.

memory_candidates.content: known-failures.txt rows can go stale: a row's reason text can describe a defect that was already fixed by an earlier commit, while the suite stays red for an unrelated, later-introduced reason. Before trusting a known-failures.txt row (or any 'already registered' defect description), re-run the suite and match the live [FAIL] text against the row's claimed symptom shape -- do not assume the row still describes the current failure. Confirmed case: agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/test-gate-out-repair-reporting.sh's row claimed Cases 4/6 failed with fixes=0 errors=1 (a counter accumulation/reset bug), but live execution showed Case 1 failing with fixes=1 errors=1, caused by a later, unrelated validator feature.

validate-artifact.sh's generic --fix placeholder mechanism (inserts literal '- **Field**: TBD' for any missing metadata field) is intentionally unaware of field-specific grammar checks added later for individual fields (e.g. the plan-level Status-line [STATUS]-bracket check). Fixing a wholly-missing field that also carries its own grammar check will correctly leave one remaining error after the fix -- this is by design (per the script's own header comment), not a bug. Test fixtures exercising 'clean single-field repair, zero remaining errors' should pick a field with no secondary grammar check (e.g. Effort), reserving fields with secondary checks (e.g. Status) for fixtures that intentionally pin fix+error coexistence.
